title: Which are more dangerous: sharks or humans?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why are people often more afraid of sharks than of everyday risks that kill far more people?
How does media coverage change our perception of rare dangers?
Are humans more dangerous to sharks than sharks are to humans?
Should beaches be closed after a shark sighting even if the statistical risk is low?
What other animal do you think has a public reputation that does not match the real risk?
